comment: The MASTER knob's tooltip reads POT_MASTER: the maker passed the enum name rather than a label to configParam (V102-Output_Mixer.cpp:101). The panel prints MASTER and the lines follow the panel. The pan law is a linear crossfade, not constant power, so a centred channel is 6dB down on either extreme; this matches the README. The README says the LEVEL controls offer gain, but a LEVEL knob is squared into a 0 to 1 multiplier and cannot exceed unity (V102-Output_Mixer.cpp:196-197) — the gain in the module is in MASTER, which reaches four times. The meter lamps have no ParamWidget or PortWidget, so no click can reach them.
